subject: Mathematics
pedagogical_approach: Mother Tongue-Based Multilingual Education (MTB-MLE) Scaffolded Numeracy

nipun_alignment.notes: Aligns with national FLN goals of counting up to 20 objects, reading numerals 1-20, and quantity sense. Specific state alphanumeric codes are pending authoritative JCERT/NIPUN gazette verification.

core_competencies.title: Numeral Recognition & Dual-Script Association
core_competencies.description: Recognize and name numerals 1 to 20 in international digits (1..20), Devanagari digits (१..२०), Hindi spoken words, and Mundari spoken words.

core_competencies.title: One-to-One Correspondence & Counting
core_competencies.description: Count up to 20 visual objects with 1-to-1 correspondence without skipping or double-counting, using Mundari counting terms.

core_competencies.title: Ten-Frame Quantity Structuring
core_competencies.description: Understand numbers 11 to 20 as one full ten (गेल / gel) plus additional units (10 + n), forming the basis of place-value understanding.

core_competencies.title: Number Sequencing & Order
core_competencies.description: Identify predecessor, successor, and missing numbers within the sequence 1 to 20.

learning_activity_types.name: Bilingual Visual Flashcard Exploration
learning_activity_types.pedagogical_role: Introduce numeral, dual script, quantity visual, and authentic audio.

learning_activity_types.name: Audio Comprehension & Number Identification
learning_activity_types.pedagogical_role: Student hears Mundari spoken word, taps corresponding numeral.

learning_activity_types.name: Object Array Counting
learning_activity_types.pedagogical_role: Student counts objects on screen/paper, connects count to Mundari word.

learning_activity_types.name: Teacher Hindi Instruction to Mother-Tongue Bridge
learning_activity_types.pedagogical_role: Teacher inputs Hindi prompt; system presents verified Mundari translation and audio to support child understanding.

learning_activity_types.name: Printable Offline Bilingual Worksheet
learning_activity_types.pedagogical_role: Physical pencil-and-paper reinforcement in low-resource classroom.
